title.text: Consult engine — the doctor's screen as settings, not code

walk.text:
Walk board 1:
• It opens on the PATIENT BRIEF for the called token: the words typed at the front desk, vitals, allergies, last consultation, lab and radiology since, current medicines.
• Start consultation (under the brief) opens the consult with the desk complaint already as chips.
• Call next / Skip / Park in the left lane; the corridor display follows. Call next again to see Sunita's brief.
• Session drop-down: In / Out / Closed / Not started.
• Suggested drugs show pharmacy stock; add Amlong 5 (0 in stock) to see the alternative in the right pane.
• TAPS counter = speed.

why.text:
Owner's five tests on every board: accuracy, speed, auditable, compliant, dashboard UX.

Comment on any board to rule on it.
